segments.name: US operations
segments.description: Provides onshore seismic data acquisition and processing services in the continental U.S. for oil and gas companies and multi-client data library providers.
segments.evidence: We consider these two geographical areas as segments for reporting purposes.

segments.name: Canada Operations
segments.description: Provides onshore seismic data acquisition services in Canada, including for the potash mining industry, through subsidiary Eagle Canada.
segments.evidence: Seismic acquisition services of our wholly-owned subsidiary, Eagle Canada Seismic Services ULC ("Eagle Canada"), are also used by the potash mining industry in Canada, and Eagle Canada has particular expertise through its heliportable capabilities.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay fixed fees per unit of data acquired under turnkey agreements or fixed hourly, daily or monthly fees under term agreements for seismic data acquisition services.
revenueModel.evidence: We currently operate under supplemental agreements that are either "turnkey" agreements providing for a fixed fee to be paid to us for each unit of data acquired or "term" agreements providing for a fixed hourly, daily, or monthly fee during the term of the project or projects.
